# <span id="aanchor142"></span> Create Users

After installing FLOWCAL, one of the first things a company must do is create usernames and define privileges to grant users access to features and functions within the application.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Default User">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Default User</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Default User">

The default username is "FCADMIN". This user name does not appear in the User Access screen and has no other privileges except to create and maintain security access (users, groups, objects) for other users. The FCADMIN password is initially set when the database is created. Check with your DBA to obtain access to this account.

When FLOWCAL is installed for the first time or when a new database is created, the "FCADMIN" profile must be used to create the first new user.

While creating the FLOWCAL schema, change the FCADMIN password by modifying the \_createDB.sql script, which is provided as part of the installation package. Otherwise, the FLOWCAL administrator should change this password once FLOWCAL has been installed.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="New User">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />New User</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="New User">

Users can only be created from the User Access screen.

<div class="procedure">

To create a new user:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**, and select **Users** within the **Security** group.
2.  Click **New**.
3.  Enter a new unique user ID and grant the applicable privileges.
4.  Edit the password, if desired. If you do not edit the password, the account will be created with the default password "newuser". You will then be prompted to change this password upon initial log in.
5.  Click **Save**.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Administrator Account">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Administrator Account</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Administrator Account">

Quorum recommends using the FCADMIN account to create the initial administrator account with User Security privileges, then using the administrator account from that point forward to create other users and manage access.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Service Account">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Service Account</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Service Account">

All FLOWCAL services require a user account to log on to the database and process data and requests. This account can be any name, but it should be easily identifiable when viewing the audit trail (for example: "FCSRV"). This service account does not require any privileges granted from the User Access screen, but it should be set up without password expiration.

The services are configured to use this account by setting the username, password, and database to the service account within the Service Login section of the Service Configuration screen.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 251;height: 157;" />

</div>
